column1: # German (de) interface catalog. Same format and clean-room rules as zh-hans.tsv:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation (context stays empty).
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# German computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay as they are.
# Informal address (du), as is common in current German software.

column2: A free, open-source word processor written from scratch in Rust.\nPart of the Crafting Apps from the ArtCraft team.
column3: Eine freie, quelloffene Textverarbeitung, von Grund auf in Rust geschrieben.\nTeil der Crafting Apps des ArtCraft-Teams.

column2: Automatic follows your system's language. Menus and commands change; your documents don't.

column2:
Create an interactive outline of your document.

It's a great way to keep track of where you are or quickly move your content around.

To get started, go to the Home tab and apply Heading styles to the headings in your document.
column3:
Erstelle eine interaktive Gliederung deines Dokuments.

So behältst du den Überblick, wo du gerade bist, und kannst Inhalte schnell verschieben.

Wechsle zunächst zur Registerkarte „Start“ und weise den Überschriften in deinem Dokument Überschrift-Formatvorlagen zu.

column2: Documents you open will show up here.
column3: Dokumente, die du öffnest, erscheinen hier.

column2: Every command is available to scripts and AI agents: run `wordcraft-cli mcp` for an MCP server, or start the app with `--control <port>` for the JSON control channel.
column3: Jeder Befehl steht Skripten und KI-Agenten zur Verfügung: Starte `wordcraft-cli mcp` für einen MCP-Server oder die App mit `--control <port>` für den JSON-Steuerkanal.
